cd /code && Rscript - <<'RS'
rec <- read.csv('../data/rec_data_raw.csv', header=TRUE)
us <- subset(rec, country=='us' & !is.na(expenditure_rank))
uk <- subset(rec, country=='uk' & !is.na(expenditure_rank))
rec_flowchart <- function(df){
  data.frame(item=c('Institutions sampled','Public forms identified','Institutions contacted','Public forms identified after contact','Private forms provided','Forms indicated as not available to share','No response'),
             count=c(nrow(df), sum(df$included==1 & df$contacted==0), sum(df$contacted==T), sum(df$contacted==1 & df$form_available=='public', na.rm=TRUE), sum(sum(df$contacted==1 & df$form_available=='private', na.rm=TRUE)), sum(grepl('declined', df$form_available)), sum(df$form_available=='noreply' | is.na(df$form_available))))
}
print(rec_flowchart(us))
print(rec_flowchart(uk))
writeLines(capture.output(rec_flowchart(us)), '/results/us_flowchart.txt')
writeLines(capture.output(rec_flowchart(uk)), '/results/uk_flowchart.txt')
RS
